events.title: Earnings Beat, Buybacks and Raised Guidance Might Change The Case For Investing In Essex Property Trust (ESS)
events.body: In the first quarter of 2026, Essex Property Trust reported higher revenue of US$484.76 million but lower net income of US$106.19 million, while also buying back 254,001 shares for US$61.91 million as part of a US$259.24 million repurchase

events.title: UDR Q1 FFOA Matches Estimates on Steady Occupancy, Revenues Miss
events.body: UDR posts in-line Q1 FFOA as rent gains are offset by rising costs, while buybacks, asset sales and a shift to monthly dividends reshape its 2026 outlook.

events.title: INVH Q1 FFO Meets Estimates as Revenues Top on Homebuilding
events.body: INVH posts in-line Q1 FFO as revenues jump 8.8% on rental growth and new homebuilding income, offset by rising expenses and mixed leasing trends.

events.title: MAA Q1 FFO Tops Estimates, Revenues Dip, Occupancy Declines
events.body: MAA beats Q1 FFO estimates despite NOI pressure and softer rents, as leasing trends stabilize, and development, buybacks and capital plans stay on track.
